title: Lesson 18. How to search the internet
description: The search engine, short exact queries, image search and the "5 questions" quest

questions.prompt: How should you ask a search engine?
You must write "please" to a search engine.
questions.explain: It is not a person — key words matter.

questions.prompt: Where do you search for pictures?
Match the bad and the good query
pairs: please tell how many legs a spider has
I want a pretty cat picture
tell me the highest mountain in the world

questions.prompt: Where do we write the "5 questions" answers?
questions.explain: The Quest file goes into Texts.

questions.prompt: Pictures from the internet go into your Pictures folder.

learn.intro: You'll become an internet detective! We learn to find the answer to any question.

slides.text: Without a helper you can't find anything online. The helper is a **search engine**: you write a question, it finds sites with the answer.

check.prompt: A search engine finds sites with the answer.

slides.text: A search engine is not a person. It doesn't need "please" or "tell me". It needs **key words**.
Bad: "please tell me how many legs a spider usually has". Good: **"how many legs spider"**.

options: I would like to see a picture of a pretty cat

slides.text: The search engine has a **"Images"** tab. Find a picture of your favourite animal.
Save a picture: **right-click** → "Save image as" → your Pictures folder.

check.prompt: How do you save a picture from the internet?
options: Photograph the screen with a phone
